data.text:
‘COORDINATED, EVIDENCE-BASED’ FLOOD SOLUTIONS

READ: The Quezon City government thanks San Miguel Corporation Chairman and CEO Ramon Ang for offering his help to clean up river systems in a bid to address flooding in Metro Manila. 

The local government unit also appealed to government agencies, contractors, and the private sector to work with it for a “coordinated, evidence-based manner - combining river improvements with upgraded drainage systems, better network connections, and climate-resilient infrastructure.” 

📸Quezon City Government/Facebook
